svg.aria-label: AI engineer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at ASU in May 2027. I animate, build the tools animators use and train the AI models behind them. At UNOMi I work on our animation plugins for Maya, Blender, Unreal and Cinema 4D and made our markerless motion capture 2.8x faster at the same accuracy. On my own I train PPO agents on a CUDA simulator I wrote, and I have a passion for hand keyframed animation.
